query: I have a 56‑year‑old male in the ICU. Among male ICU patients aged 51–61, categorize first‑48‑hour per‑stay average SpO2 (<90, 90–92, 93–95, >95) and report patient counts and AKI rates.
final_sql: SELECT a.avg_spo2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS patient_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.avg_spo2 < 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS akis FROM avg_spo2 a WHERE a.avg_spo2 BETWEEN 90 AND 95 GROUP BY a.avg_spo2;
